scope: Real desktop frontend and dialogs; auth/cloud/companion operations use token-free DEV fixtures

checks.name: Native overview shows three central profiles
Navigation exposes the five product areas
Profile relationships group browsers under two Macs
Remote connections do not claim a live synced state
A second local source cannot be connected silently
Primary profile view hides internal identifiers
Native modal has a labelled title and contains focus
Dialog cancellation restores the invoking control
Blank profile names have an inline validation error
Duplicate names are rejected before creating a profile
Starting fresh does not connect or change a browser
Mapping stays pending until the companion confirms it
Companion confirmation alone does not announce first sync
First sync completion follows actual observed fixture sync
Renaming preserves the existing browser relationship
Disconnect explains that local browser data is kept
Disconnect retains the central profile
First entry explains the browser to central-profile relationship
Permission guidance is specific and offers Helium without access
Import creates a core profile and maps its chosen local origin
Import does not invent a completed sync
Companion instructions show a concrete setup path
Incomplete setup remains discoverable on its profile
An open browser produces guidance before connecting
The pending browser link does not claim sync is active
Retry advances to companion setup after the browser closes
Delete explicitly distinguishes cloud and local data
Delete requires the exact profile name
A mismatched confirmation cannot delete
A failed disconnection keeps the cloud profile for retry
Delete removes all mappings and profile cloud files
Deleting a cloud profile preserves every browser fixture
Incomplete cloud cleanup does not appear as full deletion success
Conflict comparison presents local and remote versions
Conflict decisions update the actual fixture state
Sign in is a labelled native desktop form
Validation focuses the field needing correction
Native auth errors get specific plain-language feedback
Signup has immediate password validation
Email confirmation is shown as pending success
Successful sign in enters progressive onboarding
Sign out explains pause and preserved data
Signing out returns to the auth form
Offline has a clear data-preservation notice
Offline connection state does not claim synced
Empty state offers import and starting fresh
Dark appearance is applied and its selection announced
Light appearance is applied and persisted
Current native window has no horizontal page overflow
Visible controls have accessible names

limitations: No live cloud auth, real browser data, OS permission grants or companion installation were exercised.
Native pointer/keyboard interaction and screenshots are validated separately through Computer Use.
Window overflow is measured at the actual native size; resize to 720 px and rerun to verify a narrow window.
